thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-76543 fired - Postgres connection pool saturation on prod-primary. Alerts: high connection_count, pgbouncer auth errors, 502/504 spike. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/prod/pg/pool

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-76543 -> triggered, escalation policy: oncall-engineering, action: page 1 (sara).

sara (oncall): ACK. I'm looking. Seeing 502 spikes in frontends and a bunch of pgbouncer logs showing "no available connections".

james (db): saw this too on the metrics - max_client_conn reached on pgbouncer, connection_wait_count increasing. Could be a traffic surge or leak.

maria (infra): infra side - Redis replication lag also climbed briefly but seems stabilizing. Postgres is the main pain.

incident-bot: Snapshot: errors 5xx up 18% in last 5m, pgbouncer stats: cl_active=360, cl_waiting=120, max_client_conn=500, client_connections=490.

sara (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) temporary increase pgbouncer max_client_conn to 800, 2) reduce app worker concurrency for gen endpoints, 3) route non-critical traffic to standby region if possible. James, okay to bump?

james (db): Bump is OK as emergency short-term. Also check for long-lived idle_in_transaction sessions - if present, kill. Run: 
```
SELECT pid, state, query, age(clock_timestamp(), query_start) AS duration
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE state <> 'idle'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

sara (oncall): Running that now. A few long-running queries from embeddings-worker-2 - looks like batched ingest stuck.

support (ops): Noted increased 502s from customers on the gen endpoint - support ticket volume rising. I'm preparing a short message for status page if we can't stabilize in 30m.

maria (infra): I'm adding an autoscale to app-workers (scale down batch workers) and throttling the embeddings ingestion queue. Pushing config to feature-flag: embeddings_ingest: rate_limit=50/s.

alex (sre): Heads-up: if we increase pgbouncer too much without increasing DB max_connections, we'll push more to postgres. Consider enabling pgbouncer transaction pooling and add a read-only pool to reroute analytical noise.

james (db): Good call. Current postgres max_connections=1000; active backends approx 650. We have headroom, but autovacuum could be impacted. I'll temporarily raise work_mem? better to just accept more connections for <1h.

sara (oncall): Implementing quick changes: 1) pgbouncer max_client_conn 500->800 (applying now) 2) toggle embeddings rate limit flag 3) kill top 5 long-running queries after notifying owners.

incident-bot: change-request: pgbouncer-config-update -> applied by maria @ 3798765490.

maria (infra): pgbouncer config applied, restarting pgbouncer poolers one at a time to avoid connection storms. Restart logs: 
```
systemctl restart pgbouncer@pooler-1 && sleep 5 && systemctl status pgbouncer@pooler-1
```

james (db): Killed 4 queries holding transactions open (pids: 8421, 8437, 8440, 8499). Monitoring.

sara (oncall): Frontend 5xx rate dropping from 18% -> 7% in last 3m. Client waiting count decreased to ~30. Good signs.

support (ops): Notifying CS with a short blurb: "We are experiencing intermittent errors on generation API due to DB saturation; mitigation in progress. Partial customer impact; we will update in 30 minutes."

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-76543 acknowledgement recorded by sara (oncall) at 3798765512.

james (db): Also discovered an app change in last deploy that accidentally disabled prepared-statement pooling for a worker pool - causing many ephemeral connections. Rollback flagged commit c3f9a. Recommend rolling back that change on a canary.

maria (infra): I can patch the canary now to re-enable pooling. Rolling canary to 3 nodes.

alex (sre): Metrics: p95 latency for gen-api down from 1.9s to 1.1s since actions. Redis RPS was 40k at peak, now 28k. Keep an eye on replica lag.

sara (oncall): Status update for thread: impact: partial - ~10-15% of gen requests saw 5xx earlier, now reduced. Customers affected: some PLG users & two enterprise tenants (tenant-42, tenant-gamma) reported errors. Next steps: continue monitoring 30m, prepare long-term fix (revert pooling change + add connection quotas per service), and handoff if persists.

james (db): I'll open a follow-up RFC for connection quotas and more robust prepared-stmt pooling tests. For now, adding pgbouncer stats alert refinement to catch waiting>50 for >5m.

maria (infra): Pushed a rollback to canary nodes. No new error spikes on canary. Rolling to remainder in controlled waves.

sara (oncall): Good. I'm going to hand off to alex for overnight watch at 3800000000 (local shift). Leaving incident live with notes and mitigation steps. If error rate creep >5% again, escalate PD to second level.

alex (sre): ACK takeover. I'll keep monitoring and will escalate to james if DB backends > 800 for >10m. Also opening INC-2026-09 with timeline/actions.

support (ops): Marking support tickets with incident tag PD-76543. Drafted status page update queued.

incident-bot: PD-76543 -> status: acknowledged, current severity: partial outage, assigned: alex (sre).

sara (oncall): Final note before handoff: owners of embeddings-worker alerted to inspect the batch job causing the leak. I've attached query IDs and stack traces to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:

alex (sre): Taking it from here. Will post a 1h update or earlier if anything changes.

pagerduty-bot: PD-76543 -> escalation policy paused for active ack (alex).

-- end of thread --
